name: @airness/node
description: The JS/TS gates of the Airness node layer, the analyzer configurations they read, and the pinned analyzers.
author: Herman Ciechanowiec <herman@ciechanowiec.eu>

coverageExclude.reason: the executable's entry point, which runs only as a process of its own; the command line it starts is measured
the ESLint configuration, which ESLint loads in a process of its own during the eslint gate, where the gate specs run it and coverage does not reach
read only by the ESLint configuration, in the process ESLint runs it in

the accessibility scans and the route walk the shipped sweep and a project's own specs call, which run only inside a Playwright worker during the e2e gate; the rules they apply are measured in their own modules
the layout measurement, whose page code runs in the browser Playwright drives during the e2e gate; the rules that judge its snapshot are measured in their own modules
the wait before a scan, which runs only in the browser page Playwright drives during the e2e gate
the Playwright assertion over a received response, which runs only inside a Playwright worker; the header baseline it applies is measured in security-headers.ts
the Playwright configuration, which Playwright loads in a process of its own during the e2e gate

the launcher of a Next.js production build and the loaders of its configuration and environment, which run only inside the Playwright run of the e2e gate against an installed Next; the output selection they apply is measured in production-output.ts
the TCP probe of the browser endpoint, which opens sockets and resolves hostnames; the decisions it feeds are measured in browser-server-policy.ts

generatedArtefacts.reason: the CycloneDX 1.6 JSON schema, vendored verbatim from the CycloneDX specification so the SBOM spec validates offline
